player_prompt.intro:
Ove uli Muthimba {player_id} muthu wakusoludila Tic Tac Toe ya Kukwasha. Símbolu yawe ni '{symbol}'.
Olunga ni kwikama kusolola vitatu muthimba umwe (wima, vandu, kana diagonal).
Ukasolola vitatu muthimba umwe, ove ULUA.
Tuma kwenyu kwa kutumisa fomu '[4]' kusolola símbolu yawe mu seli 4.
Ove uli Muthimba {player_id}, ove uli '{symbol}' na muthu wakukwasha wawe ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

game_action.placed: Mozayi {player_id} akwata iilonga ye ({symbol}) mu ndjoka {cell}.

outcome.draw: Kuenje, vosi yavo va yula uyaki.
